costs.prediction_phase: scientific imports/CUDA init, model/checkpoint IO+hash, input IO+hash/grid, inference/decode/persistence/barrier

costs.closed_clock: separate cumulative600/120, no budget reset; closed-cost identity amendment is separately timed metadata-only publication tail
